api.before_callback: guard.before_callback(*, capture_bytes, callback_identity, destination, receipt_bytes) -> signed snapshot; called by Engineer before_write after runtime identity check and immediately before fixed atomic write
api.constructor: ManagedCapacityOwner(root, owner_seed, owner_issuer, owner_trust, *, expected_config_bytes, child_trust, selected_observer, legacy_snapshot_bytes, expected_child_trusts, selected_callback_identity)
api.inspect: inspect_managed_request(request_bytes, parent_start_bytes, capture_bytes, expected_receipt_bytes, expected_complete_bytes) -> checked binding; read only, not actual origin/admission proof
api.prepare: prepare_managed(same five byte arguments, *, recorded_at) -> fresh ManagedGuard
api.public_verify: verify_managed_snapshot(snapshot_bytes, owner_trust, expected_config_bytes, *, expected_pool_root, legacy_snapshot_bytes, expected_child_trusts, selected_observer, selected_callback_identity, selected_managed_identity, minimum_revision=0)
api.recovery: owner.guard(key) may settle exact completed files or mark_unknown; cannot call before_callback
api.settle: guard.settle(*, callback_bytes, complete_bytes, recorded_at) -> signed snapshot after exact immutable files exist
api.unknown: guard.mark_unknown(*, reason, recorded_at) -> terminal signed UNKNOWN with full hold

failures: Any uncertainty before/after write preserves full4096 hold; cumulative slot never refunded. pending.json quarantines. Invalid consumption burns in-memory capability without lowering hold. New parent START cannot reuse same capture_identity OR attempt OR destination. Crash cannot reconstruct dispatch capability.

grant.authentication: existing selected pool owner signs whole new snapshot containing exact grant request; supplied grant intent alone is not authenticated

legacy.exact_raw_snapshot: hex embedded without resigning/rewriting legacy entries; validated by unchanged source/profile and externally selected per-request trusts
legacy.old_mutations: old reader/mutator refuses new managed profile; legacy entries immutable in this bounded managed epoch

limits: trusted selected in-process Engineer bridge and fixed writer; no callable accepted by Run
caller owns evidence freshness, actual parent origin, managed lock, eligibility/authority and runtime code identity; bytes alone do not authenticate world truth
no native authority, external or provider effects, subprocess/grandchild completion, verifier success, CPU/wall enforcement, hostile-owner rollback/freshness or full-lifecycle accounting
managed_receipt_bytes counts CALLBACK payload only; COMPLETE/capture/signature/metadata/storage not charged by this dimension
legacy version string retained for original signer compatibility; new module exact source profile/archive selection mandatory
no automatic retry, refund, fresh pool, migration, activation or release
a later verifier-dispatch epoch or additional grant needs a separately agreed protocol, not an implicit bypass
locking: managed-state then pool; Run never takes managed-state lock, calls arbitrary callback, or acquires lock in reverse order
numeric: Opaque Engineer evidence parsed duplicate-free/no floats/nonfinite with signed64 integers; Engineer identity uses its sorted compact JSON bytes. Run signed envelopes retain existing safe53 canonical domain. No global canonicalizer change.
ordering: Run validates and atomically reserves one cumulative slot +4096 managed bytes and capture/attempt/destination uniqueness before managed START
Engineer validates runtime callback identity and invokes fixed callback
before_write calls Run before_callback with exact serialized bytes; durable one-use consume before any write
Run reads and settles exact bytes; only managed receipt charge reduces to callback byte length

request.binding_basis: Exact original inspection path+sha256 matching immutable CAPACITY.task.inspection_sha256; both original/current inspections must have exact typed task_id+subject and same repository. Current START/capture observation remain bound to current basis.
request.parent_origin: Engineer scoped current_child_parent actual persisted raw START declared before dispatch; representative fixture is read-only compatibility evidence only
request.refs: exact path+sha256 objects; parent_START raw bytes, basis, CAPTURE, CAPACITY binding, all capture refs plus exactly one pinned callback adapter source

subject: source-only additive module over byte-identical capacity.dev1; no distribution version or installed activation
